Name: (CP) Spooky Wallpapers and Floors Redux..... TWO
Author: Zythalia
Description:
[size=3]This mod is a Content Patcher port of the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3179]Spooky Wallpapers and Floors Redux[/url] mod I uploaded in 2018. It uses textures created by [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6056304?tab=user+files]Serpentwined/adelein14[/url], as well as Content Patcher code by [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/users/151924203]Sevinae[/url], which allows new wallpapers and floors to be added without having to overwrite vanilla ones.
[/size][size=2](I cut two wallpapers out to make this mod work, but they were both recolors of the bats-flying-at-sunset one which I've never seen anyone use.)[/size][size=4]

Suggested mod to pair with this one - [u][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5766](CP) SPOOKY GOTHIC FURNITURE[/url]﻿[/b]

How To Install:[/u][/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley\Mods folder[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][u]How To Use:[/u][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]All wallpapers and floors can be found in the Catalogue sold at Pierre's shop. You'll have to scroll to the bottom of their respective categories to find them.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][u]Thumbnail Credits[/u][/size][size=3]: [NOTE: I took these thumbnails in 2018. Many of the mods listed here are now deprecated.][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]The clothes in one of the example thumbnails are from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1128]New Shirts and 2 New Skirts[/url]﻿, with the shirt via [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2439]a port[/url]﻿ using [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2416]Custom Shirts[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]The hair shown in the thumbnail is from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2869]Coii's Hair Sets Pack[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Much of the furniture shown is from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3128]Redwood Furniture[/url]﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3121]Witch Furniture[/url]﻿, which use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url]﻿.[/size]
[/list]
